evidence.source: Development fast-lane rollout of contracts 181, 182 and 183, run 31608311593 from exact main 0fbe591199695258ab0a89baa6035ccd87a56369, applied under ADR 0024 because all three are additive and the lane proves that by reading the pending set rather than trusting the dispatcher. The additive checker was also run locally before dispatch, so a refusal would have been known before a hosted environment was touched rather than after. CONFIRMED BY NAMING THE ROWS, not by counting them, which is the lesson of 11 August 2026 when a count against a hosted ledger stayed stale for twenty-five minutes after a successful apply: the ledger holds 183 rows and NAMES 20260812030000 private_league_member_limit, 20260812040000 single_group_stage_authority and 20260812050000 season_clubs_and_leaderboard_neighbourhood. The workflow's own closing step said 'Development is at contract 183'; this record is an independent read-only postflight and not that sentence. CONTRACT 181'S ONE REAL RISK IS MEASURED CLOSED. It is the only migration in the range the additive checker did not pass silently: it drops the trigger enforce_league_member_limit on public.league_members and re-creates it, which the checker reports as structural rather than refusing. The installed catalogue holds that trigger present and non-internal on league_members, so it was re-created rather than left dropped -- a cap that had silently stopped existing would look exactly like a successful apply. The stored league_member_limit is 100, and the largest league on this project holds 15 members, so CAP-003 cannot have retroactively invalidated an existing league. GRANTS, measured on the installed definitions rather than the migration text: get_season_clubs and get_season_leaderboard_neighbourhood are executable by authenticated and by NO anonymous role, and set_league_member_limit is executable by service_role alone -- so contract 181's ceiling cannot be changed from a browser. IT SCHEDULES NOTHING: ten cron jobs, the same ten the 179/180 record measured, and none added by this range. Euro publication is still hidden and EURO-001 is unchanged. It launched no competition, drew no Championship, opened no Last Man Standing, confirmed no provider result and imported no football. NOTHING PLAYER-OWNED WAS WRITTEN: the only INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE anywhere in the three files is an update of predictor_internal.operating_limits inside the BODY of set_league_member_limit, which is what that function does when someone calls it rather than what the migration does -- the same distinction that once made an earlier form of this guard refuse contract 66 over a delete inside an RPC. Measured after the apply: 24 auth users and 39 league memberships. THE FRONTEND IS STILL NOT REACHABLE AT THIS RANGE: src/services/supabase/database.types.meta.json records generatedFromContract 178, so contracts 179 to 183 are hosted on Development and not callable in a type-safe way from the browser until the types are regenerated. MIG-UI-20 stays blocked for that reason and no application promotion is claimed here. Production is untouched and remains at 178; it has no fast lane and the workflow refuses its project ref outright.
